title: How Often Should You Send Out Marketing Emails?

facts.fact: The page states that the average email open rate hovers at around 20 percent, depending on the industry, citing research by MailChimp (a third-party source).
facts.quote: the average email open rate hovers at around 20 percent, depending on the industry, according to research by MailChimp

facts.fact: The page's own rough estimate is that a click-through rate of about 3 percent among those who open an email is a good result, with the vendor describing this as being lucky to reach it.
facts.quote: And click-through rates? You're lucky if 3 percent of those who open your email click on a link.
